entries.original_title: The Marley hypothesis: Denial of racism reflects ignorance of history
entries.original_authors: Nelson, J.; Adams, G.; Salter, P.
entries.description: Study 1: Replicated the Marley hypothesis that knowledge of historical racism mediates racial differences in perceptions of present racism.
entries.notes: Authors explicitly state Study 1 failed to replicate the Marley hypothesis. Original authors (Nelson et al., 2013) are not named in the text; only cited as [13]. Statistical fields left blank as per instructions.
